The first release of the maintained fork of [itaysk/kubectl-neat](https://github.com/itaysk/kubectl-neat). It continues its version history: the last upstream release was `v2.0.4`.

## Why a major version

**The output is different.** kubectl-neat now removes a lot that `v2` left in, so if you diff neat output, commit it to git, or test against it, expect changes:

- **Defaults for every built-in API group**, not just core/v1. Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs, CronJobs and HPAs lose `progressDeadlineSeconds`, `revisionHistoryLimit`, the rolling-update block and all pod-template defaults. A plain Deployment goes from 37 lines to 19.
- **Pods** lose `priority`, `preemptionPolicy`, `serviceAccountName: default`, the two 300-second `NoExecute` tolerations, and `kube-api-access-*` token volumes.
- **Services** lose an allocated `clusterIP`/`clusterIPs` and default single-stack IPv4 settings. Headless Services keep `clusterIP: None`.
- **Jobs** lose the generated selector and `controller-uid`/`job-name` labels, so they can be re-applied.
- **Everywhere**: `creationTimestamp: null` in templates, rollout-history annotations, `kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt`, `kubernetes.io/change-cause`, CNI and kubelet annotations, OpenShift SCC and per-namespace UID ranges, generated Route hosts, and Argo CD / Flux / kustomize tracking metadata.

The Readme has [the full list and the rule behind it](https://github.com/ayates83/kubectl-neat#controllers-platforms-and-tools).

**The CLI is stricter.** Stray positional arguments are an error instead of being ignored while stdin is read.

## New

- Multi-document YAML input (`---`).
- `--strip-annotation` / `--strip-label` and `KUBECTL_NEAT_STRIP_ANNOTATIONS` / `KUBECTL_NEAT_STRIP_LABELS`.
- Diff mode: `export KUBECTL_EXTERNAL_DIFF="kubectl-neat --diff"`, then `kubectl diff` as usual.
- Windows builds.

## Fixed

- **v2 could invert what a manifest does.** It removed every empty object and list, but in Kubernetes emptiness can mean "everything":
  - an allow-all NetworkPolicy (`egress: [{}]`) became deny-all
  - a rule admitting every namespace (`from: [{namespaceSelector: {}}]`) was deleted
  - a PodDisruptionBudget with `selector: {}` stopped covering any pod

  Empty list elements and empty label selectors are now always kept. If you have applied v2 output of NetworkPolicies or PodDisruptionBudgets, compare it with the source.
- **v2 deleted empty-string values it mistook for defaults.** An empty argument disappeared from `args: ["--name", ""]`, changing the command line, and `env` values of `""` were dropped. A field now counts as default only when the API server's defaulting actually sets it, and list items such as arguments are never candidates.
- A map key containing path syntax (`#`, `*`, `?`, `|`) could make neat print an empty document.
- `kubectl neat get` failed whenever kubectl printed a warning, and did not recognise `-ojson` or `--output=json`.
- Invalid input shorter than 20 characters caused a panic.

## Also changed

- JSON output is consistently indented, like `kubectl -o json`.
- YAML output is deterministic. go-yaml, which `kubectl -o yaml` also uses, can print map keys in a different order on every run when keys have leading zeros (`00-base.conf`, `010-extra.conf`), which makes committed output churn. Key order is otherwise unchanged: on a test cluster, all 3,003 objects printed byte-identical YAML before and after.
- Large lists are much faster: a whole cluster's ConfigMaps (11 MB) take under 2 seconds instead of 30, and Pods about 7 instead of 30.

## Install

Download the archive for your platform below, or install with krew from this release's manifest:

```bash
kubectl krew install --manifest-url=https://github.com/ayates83/kubectl-neat/releases/download/{{ .Tag }}/neat.yaml
```

`kubectl krew install neat` installs upstream `v2.0.4`, not this release. Remove it first if you have it (`kubectl krew uninstall neat`). `kubectl neat version` shows which one you are running.

On macOS the binaries are not notarized. If Gatekeeper blocks them, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine ./kubectl-neat`.
